title: Fix ViewDesigner test: substring match on Tailwind hover class
body:
`not.toContain('border-primary')` false-positives against `hover:border-primary/50` in the non-selected button state.

- Changed assertion to check `bg-primary` which is unique to the selected state and avoids substring collision with hover utilities

```diff
- expect(gridBtn.className).not.toContain('border-primary');
+ expect(gridBtn.className).not.toContain('bg-primary');
```
